facts.text: Eligible undergraduate students residing across Pennsylvania, West Virginia, and designated Appalachian counties qualify for FSU's lower in-state tuition rate.

sources.title: Dear Bobcats, I'm pleased to share two important tuition initiatives ...
sources.quote: Beginning next fall (academic year 2027–2028), eligible undergraduate students whose permanent home address is in any county in Pennsylvania and West Virginia, and select counties in northern Virginia, eastern Ohio, and southern New York, will qualify for FSU's in-state tuition rate.
